cards.hint: One input gives one single output every time
cards.quote: the value of one variable in a problem depends uniquely on the value of another variable in the problem
cards.stem: What kind of link between two changing quantities makes the link a function

cards.hint: Recall the three named triangle ratios
cards.quote: The trigonometric functions sine, cosine, and tangent relate the various sides and angles of a triangle.
cards.stem: Which three ratios link the sides and angles of a triangle

cards.hint: Common factors cancel and leave the basic ratio
cards.quote: Dividing out the “2’s” gives x divided by y, the same value as the black triangle.
cards.stem: After doubling both sides, what ratio still gives the cosine for the red triangle

cards.hint: Tables link angles to ratios, so one side is enough
cards.quote: If we know the length of any one side, we can solve for the length of the other sides.
cards.stem: With angle tables, what known measure lets you find the remaining sides
